svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: Any YouTube video in, sheet music and tab out
svg.desc: Any YouTube video in, sheet music and tab out. 21 components in 6 groups. Connections: YouTube or SoundCloud link to Download + decode (yt-dlp, ffmpeg) (link); Audio file (MP3, WAV, FLAC...) to Download + decode (yt-dlp, ffmpeg) (file); Download + decode (yt-dlp, ffmpeg) to Demucs htdemucs_6s (audio); Demucs htdemucs_6s to Six stems (6 stems); Six stems to Beat tracking (beat_this) (drums stem); Beat tracking (beat_this) to Beat grid (beats.json) (beat times); Six stems to Vocal split (UVR Karaoke 2) (vocals (optional)); Vocal split (UVR Karaoke 2) to Lead and backing vocals (lead + backing); Six stems to CREPE + pitch-to-notes (vocals, bass); Lead and backing vocals to CREPE + pitch-to-notes (lead vocals); Six stems to ByteDance piano model (piano); Six stems to YourMT3+ (guitar, other, drums); Lead and backing vocals to YourMT3+ (backing vocals); CREPE + pitch-to-notes to Raw notes per stem (notes); ByteDance piano model to Raw notes per stem (notes, velocities); YourMT3+ to Raw notes per stem (notes; drums as GM keys); Raw notes per stem to Quantise on beat grid (notes); Beat grid (beats.json) to Quantise on beat grid (beat grid); Raw notes per stem to MIDI file (as played); Quantise on beat grid to MIDI file (quantised); Quantise on beat grid to Fingering (guitar, bass) (guitar, bass); Quantise on beat grid to MusicXML score (bars); Fingering (guitar, bass) to MusicXML score (tab staves); Quantise on beat grid to alphaTex score (bars); and more.

text.tspan: ANY YOUTUBE VIDEO IN, SHEET MUSIC AND TAB OUT
Default routes; each stem's model can be changed with STEMDECK_TRANSCRIBE_<STEM>
